claims.title: Climate change is undeniable

claims.title: Tobacco industry claimed smoking was healthy

claims.title: Meal timing doesn't impact weight loss

claims.title: Fat is essential for nutrient absorption

claims.title: Carbs are not the enemy of weight loss

claims.title: Gluten-free for weight loss is a marketing ploy
claims.claim: Marketting drives the trend of gluten-free diets for weight loss.
